brand_names: On Top of the World Communities
profile.org_note: Single-market, family-run company: Kenneth D. Colen is President (since 1981) and is listed by Builder as CEO; On Top of the World Communities, LLC is the affiliated community entity and Colen Built Development, LLC the builder/developer (both named in the shared legal notice). Land decisions sit with the Colen family and a VP of land entitlements, acquisitions and development (Robert 'Bo' Stepp, per Jan 2025 press); finance is run by a VP of Finance (seat advertised April 2025, holder not public) who reports to senior leadership and a Board of Directors.
profile.summary: Not a conventional multi-market homebuilder: Colen Built Development, LLC is the family-owned (Colen family) builder-developer of On Top of the World Communities, a 55+ active-adult master plan in Ocala, FL, plus the family-oriented Calesa Township (planned ~5,000 homes on ~1,500 acres) and the newer 55+ Melody Preserve, all in southwest Ocala/Marion County. It builds on land the family has owned since buying the 13,000-acre Circle Square Ranch in 1975, and the company describes itself as debt-free; that makes it a weak land-banking prospect (it owns its pipeline outright and does not buy finished lots), though a possible counterparty as a land seller or for a future out-of-county expansion. Builder 100 2026 rank 83: 650 closings and $289M revenue in 2025, up from 503 closings and $233M in 2024.
